# jianmu

> jianmu is a free, open-source (MIT) desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that lets every AI coding agent use every model. Add a provider once (DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, Qwen, MiniMax, OpenRouter, Ollama, or the Claude and ChatGPT subscriptions you already pay for), then pick it in Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI or any other agent. It runs a local gateway that speaks the OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini APIs and translates between them, with streaming, tool calls and reasoning intact.

jianmu lives in the menu bar (tray on Windows and Linux), with a full window, a TUI and a CLI. The Mac download is about 15 MB, built on the system WebView (no Electron). It is signed and notarised on macOS and updates itself.

Key facts:

- Website: https://usejianmu.ai/ (English), https://usejianmu.ai/zh/ (中文), https://usejianmu.ai/ja/ (日本語), https://usejianmu.ai/de/ (Deutsch)
- Source code: https://github.com/DamonZS/Jianmu
- Downloads: https://github.com/DamonZS/Jianmu/releases/latest
- Install from a terminal (macOS, Linux): `curl -fsSL https://usejianmu.ai/install.sh | sh`
- Community: Discord, linked from the website
- Price: free
- Full text of every docs page in one file: https://usejianmu.ai/llms-full.txt

## What it does

- **One model switcher for every agent.** Each agent can use a different provider's model: Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, Gemini CLI on GLM. jianmu edits only the one setting it changes in each agent's config (settings.json, config.toml, config.yaml), keeping comments, order and indentation, and restores it when you pick the agent's own model again.
- **A local gateway at 127.0.0.1:3425.** It speaks OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages and Google Gemini, and translates in both directions, so Codex (Responses only) and Claude Code (Messages only) can use any vendor's model. Any client that can set a base URL can use it: `OPENAI_BASE_URL`, `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, `GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL`.
- **Subscription sharing.** A sign-in you made in one agent becomes a provider every other agent can use: a Claude Pro/Max sign-in in OpenCode, Pi or Goose; a ChatGPT Plus/Pro sign-in in Claude Code; a GitHub Copilot seat in any agent.
- **Routing.** Put several keys and subscriptions behind one model name. jianmu picks the account for each request (by intent, in order, round robin, least used first, or by which quota resets first), skips rate-limited and out-of-credit accounts for as long as the vendor says, and fails over to the next account before the agent sees an error. Intent routing asks a small fast model which of your rules a turn belongs to.
- **Privacy masking.** Before a request leaves the computer, jianmu replaces API keys, private keys, tokens, email addresses, and card and ID numbers with placeholders, and puts the real values back in replies and tool calls. An optional local model also finds names, addresses and passwords. Values are never written to disk.
- **Usage per agent.** Tokens, cache hits and cost for every agent and model that goes through the gateway.
- **Library.** Instructions, MCP servers, skills, hooks and subagents written once for every agent, and an MCP router.
- **Remote and Docker.** Share one jianmu on the network, or run it in Docker on a server or NAS (`ghcr.io/DamonZS/Jianmu`).
- **Plugins.** OpenCode plugins add providers and subscriptions.

## Supported agents

Claude Code, Claude Desktop (chat, Code and Cowork), Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Pi, Goose, Cursor CLI, GitHub Copilot CLI, VS Code, Crush, Droid, Kimi Code, Grok Build, Hermes Agent, Devin, MiniMax Code, MiMo Code, DevEco Code, Command Code, ZCode, Snow CLI, Alma, Cherry Studio and more.

## Supported providers

DeepSeek, Kimi (Moonshot), GLM (Zhipu), Qwen, MiniMax, Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI, Google Gemini, Mistral, xAI, Groq, OpenRouter, AiHubMix, Ollama and other local servers, any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint, plus Claude, ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot subscriptions.

## Docs

- [Get started](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/start): how jianmu fits together; add providers, pick a model for each agent, route one model over several accounts.
- [Models in Claude Code](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/claude-code-models): run Claude Code on DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, Qwen, MiniMax or a ChatGPT plan's GPT models; how the opus, sonnet and haiku tiers map and what changes in settings.json.
- [Models in Codex](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/codex-models): run Codex on DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, Qwen or a Claude subscription; the /model list with reasoning efforts and what changes in config.toml.
- [Models in Gemini CLI](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/gemini-cli-models): run Gemini CLI on DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, Qwen or a Claude or ChatGPT subscription; what changes in ~/.gemini/.env and settings.json, and how to switch back.
- [Subscriptions in any agent](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/subscriptions): sign in to Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Gemini Code Assist or Antigravity in jianmu and use its models in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or OpenCode, with several accounts and failover.
- [ChatGPT in Claude Code](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/claude-code-chatgpt): use a ChatGPT Plus or Pro subscription in Claude Code with no API key; signing in, picking a GPT model, how the opus, sonnet and haiku tiers map, reasoning effort, usage limits, several accounts and switching back.
- [Local models in Claude Code and Codex](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/local-models): run Claude Code and Codex on Ollama, LM Studio, oMLX, MLX-Serve, vLLM or llama.cpp; default addresses, which API each server speaks, context window and masking.
- [Models in OpenCode](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/opencode-models): run OpenCode on DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM, Qwen or a Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot subscription; what jianmu writes in opencode.json, reasoning variants and cost, and how to switch back.
- [jianmu vs CC Switch vs Claude Code Router](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/alternatives): a fair comparison of the three: agents, config rewrite or local proxy, protocol translation, subscription sign-ins, routing and failover, GUI and CLI, platforms and license, and which one fits.
- [DeepSeek in every agent](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/deepseek): use DeepSeek V4 in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode; the API key, endpoints, thinking on tool turns, reasoning effort, prompt cache and balance.
- [Kimi K2 and Kimi Code in every agent](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/kimi): Kimi API or Kimi Code membership keys, global and China endpoints, in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode; usage windows and web search.
- [GLM Coding Plan in every agent](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/glm): Zhipu GLM and Z.ai, pay as you go or Coding Plan, each plan's endpoints, the 1113 "insufficient balance" fix, thinking and plan windows.
- [Volcengine Ark Coding Plan in every agent](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/volcengine): 火山方舟 Coding Plan, Agent Plan and pay as you go, each plan's endpoints, its Doubao, GLM, DeepSeek and Kimi models, Ark's own web search, Seedream and Seedance, and the plan windows through an AccessKey.
- [Tencent Cloud Token Plan in Claude Code and Codex](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/tencent-cloud): TokenHub's personal and enterprise Token Plan and pay as you go, their endpoints and models, and the enterprise quota read with a SecretId and SecretKey.
- [Baidu Qianfan Token Plan in Claude Code and Codex](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/baidu-qianfan): Qianfan's personal and enterprise Token Plans and pay as you go, their endpoints, and the DeepSeek and GLM models each plan has.
- [SiliconFlow in Claude Code and Codex](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/siliconflow): SiliconFlow's China and Global sites, model names with their maker, Chat Completions converted for Claude Code and Codex, and the retired balance query.
- [ModelScope in Claude Code and Codex](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/modelscope): ModelScope API-Inference on an access token, not DashScope; Chat Completions and Responses; its async image tasks.
- [Huawei Cloud MaaS Token Plan in Claude Code and Codex](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/huaweicloud): the Token Plan and pay as you go endpoints at api.modelarts-maas.com, GLM, Kimi and DeepSeek, Codex converted to Chat Completions.
- [Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan in Claude Code and Codex](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/xiaomi-mimo): tp- keys per region (China, Singapore, Europe) and pay as you go, Chat, Responses and Anthropic at each host, mimo-v2.6-pro.
- [StepFun Step Plan in Claude Code and Codex](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/stepfun): China (api.stepfun.com) and international (api.stepfun.ai) sites, Step Plan keys only at step_plan, Codex converted, the 5-hour and weekly windows via a platform sign-in.
- [Meituan LongCat in Claude Code and Codex](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/longcat): api.longcat.chat with Chat, Responses and Anthropic, the key as a Bearer, LongCat-2.0.
- [Qwen in every agent](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/qwen): Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (DashScope), Bailian, the Qwen and Bailian Token Plans and Qwen Cloud in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode; which endpoint each key works on, thinking and images.
- [MiniMax and the Coding Plan in every agent](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/minimax): MiniMax M3 and M2.7, pay as you go or Coding Plan keys, global and China endpoints, interleaved thinking, effort and the plan's usage windows.
- [OpenRouter in every agent](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/openrouter): one OpenRouter key for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode; which endpoint each agent's requests use, the model list, reasoning, Claude's prompt cache, cost and credits, several keys and free models.
- [GitHub Copilot in every agent](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/copilot): a Copilot seat's models in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode; signing in (editors, Copilot CLI, GHE.com), Copilot Auto, premium requests, several accounts and errors.
- [Gemini in every agent](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/gemini): a Google AI Studio key (or Vertex AI) in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode; endpoints, thinking levels, thought signatures across tool calls, tool schemas, search and rate limits.
- [Grok in every agent](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/grok): an xAI API key in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode; which API each agent's requests use, what jianmu fixes for xAI, reasoning effort, web search, prompt cache and several keys.
- [Mistral in every agent](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/mistral): a Mistral API key in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode; the model list, what jianmu fixes for Mistral (thinking parts, refused fields), effort, search, cache and the plan card.
- [Ollama in every agent](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/ollama): local Ollama, Ollama on another computer and Ollama Cloud in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode; addresses, model list, context window, reasoning, tools, masking, pricing, and jianmu as an Ollama server.
- [Anthropic in every agent](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/anthropic): an Anthropic API key in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenCode; endpoints, the model list and 1M context, prompt cache marks (5-minute and 1-hour), adaptive thinking and effort, web search, cost and workspaces.

- [Avibe on any model](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/avibe): Avibe (avibe-os, the vibe CLI) and the Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode it runs on DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Qwen, Claude or a ChatGPT subscription through jianmu: jianmu as a Model Hub source, chat completions, the model list, removing it.
- [StepCode on any model](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/stepcode): StepCode (StepFun's step command) on any model through jianmu: defaultProvider and defaultModel in ~/.stepcode/config.toml, providers.jianmu in models.json, the enabledModels scope, and switching back.
- [omp on any model](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/omp): omp (oh-my-pi) on any model through jianmu: a model and thinking level per role in ~/.omp/agent/config.yml, the jianmu provider in models.yml, enabledModels, profiles, image models, and switching back.
- [Ante on any model](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/ante): Ante (antigma.ai) on any model through jianmu: the jianmu provider and preferred_models in ~/.ante/catalog.json, provider and model in settings.json, no auth block, restarting, and switching back.
- [Aside on any model](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/aside): providers.jianmu in each Aside account's models.json, the default model, categories and image model set through aside repl, which account, switching back.
- [fx on any model](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/fx): Vercel Labs' fx (fx.sh): provider, models and a keyless providers.jianmu in ~/.fx/settings.json, the 256-model list, what the user set kept, switching back.
- [Grok App on any model](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/grok-app): RongleCat/grok-app: jianmu as the [model.jianmu] custom provider in agent-home/config.toml, models and efforts in its picker, the route switched by Use in the App, disconnecting.
- [Cherry Studio](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/cherry-studio): add jianmu to Cherry Studio as one OpenAI-compatible provider in one click, confirmed in Cherry Studio, and use every jianmu model there, Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot subscriptions included; model list, status and usage.
- [Fixing common errors](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/troubleshooting): what the gateway's errors mean and the fix: 401 and 403, 429 and rest periods, 502 and 504, model not found, an agent that doesn't show a model, port 3425 in use, agents in WSL, use from another computer and subscriptions moved to plugins.
- [Library](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/library): instructions, MCP servers, skills, hooks and subagents for each agent.
- [MCP router](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/mcp-router): one jianmu MCP server per agent.
- [Remote jianmu](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/remote): use one jianmu from several computers.
- [Docker](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/docker): run jianmu on a server or NAS.
- [Add to jianmu](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/import): import links that add a provider and its models in one click.
- [Integrate your app](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/integrate): how an AI app or agent works with jianmu's gateway.
- [Writing plugins](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/plugins): OpenCode plugins that add a provider.
- [Privacy](https://usejianmu.ai/docs/privacy): what jianmu sends on its own, and every switch that turns it off.

## Common questions

- **How do I use DeepSeek, Kimi or GLM in Claude Code?** Add the provider's key in jianmu, then pick its model for Claude Code. jianmu points Claude Code at its gateway and translates Anthropic Messages to the provider's API.
- **How do I use a model other than OpenAI's in Codex?** Add the provider in jianmu and pick the model for Codex; it appears in Codex's /model list with matching reasoning efforts.
- **Can I use my ChatGPT or Claude subscription in other agents?** Yes: sign in once in jianmu and the subscription's models appear in every agent's picker.
- **Is it a CC Switch or claude-code-router alternative?** It covers much of the same ground for every agent at once: switching providers, a translating gateway, routing and failover. See the comparison: https://usejianmu.ai/docs/alternatives
- **Does jianmu read API keys from my shell?** No. It never reads keys from environment variables; it uses only what you add.
